_beeper_networks_help: Which Beeper networks to print. Must match the network names Beeper reports (case-insensitive), e.g. iMessage, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Slack, Signal, Telegram.
_filter_contacts_help: Empty = everyone. Otherwise a list of sender names or IDs to print, e.g. ['Mom', '+15551234567']
_print_media_help: print_images prints photo attachments; print_video_frames prints a still frame for videos (e.g. shared reels) via macOS Quick Look. iMessage media needs Full Disk Access -- without it the receipt still prints, just without the picture.
_printer_help: Leave printer_address empty to auto-discover by name. macOS gives each Mac its OWN BLE address for the same printer, so set PRINTER_ADDRESS in .env rather than committing an address here. Get it with --scan.
